Enabled.title: Enable product comparison
Enabled.description: Shows the compare buttons, links and page on the storefront. Off: the store has no product comparison.

MaxItems.title: Products per category
MaxItems.description: How many products a buyer can compare in one category.

AnonymousListEnabled.title: Allow guests to compare
AnonymousListEnabled.description: Off: guests are asked to sign in when they add a product to compare.

Enabled.title: Clean up compare lists
Enabled.description: Runs a job that deletes guest compare lists after their lifetime, and lists of deleted users or of organizations a user has left.

Cron.title: Cleanup schedule
Cron.description: Cron expression for the cleanup job. Daily at 02:00 by default.

AnonymousListLifetimeHours.title: Guest list lifetime, hours
AnonymousListLifetimeHours.description: A guest's compare list is deleted when it hasn't changed for this many hours.
